name: todo-api
description: REST API for todos: create a todo, list the signed-in caller's own todos, and mark one complete. Enforces that a user only ever sees and modifies their own todos. Does not edit or delete todo text, and does not serve any UI.

dependencies.name: todo-db
dependencies.description: Stores each user's todos: text and complete/incomplete status, scoped to the owning user.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates the caller's Thunder-issued token and resolves which user owns the request.
